title: The Caged Pink
descriptionLines: Arrange eight reds in a square around the pink, so that the corner reds block the pink into the nearest middle or corner pocket, with the other reds along each side of the square.

The default number of reds to use is 8 (one on each corner of the square, blocking the pink from potting, and one on the middle of each side of the square), but you could go up to all 15 reds if you want.
Pot the balls in order (i.e. red, colour, red, and so on), trying to make as high a break as possible.
This is a good break building routine, and useful for focusing on blacks, because the pink can't be potted, at least not initially.
